sources.notes: Official about page confirms Dorn as an Arizona-based professional lobbying and public affairs firm founded in 2000, with bipartisan government-relations work across federal, state, county, municipal, district, and tribal entities.

sources.notes: Official contact page confirms address at 101 N. 1st Avenue, 20th Floor, Suite 2090, Phoenix, AZ 85003, telephone 602-606-4667, and fax 602-606-4668.
